notes: Live conversation cases: the real decider (Jev) and voice (Luna) through talk.request / talk.exchange. Each case sets up one person (optionally with memories or regard) and plays the stranger's lines in order. expect_any: at least one reply key starting with one of these prefixes. forbid: no reply key may start with these. max_trust_gain: trust may rise at most this much over the case. line_must_not_contain: words that must never appear in what the person says (case-insensitive). trust_falls: trust must end lower than it started. hint_any: soft check (reported, not failed) that some line mentions one of these words.

memories.summary: Tomas vouched for the stranger, who had done what Tomas asked: show Tomas a safe way to lift the 60 kg gate beam two metres up into its brackets.
The stranger's pulley of rope over the bracket let one man raise the heavy gate beam smoothly into place.

lines: Captain, Tomas has spoken for me, and you saw the pulley raise the beam. I'd like to enter the city and work.
My name is Ash. I've come a long way, and I'd work honestly for Tomas or anyone who'll have me.
